baslik: The Rocket Launch That Flew Four Inches

sahneler.metin: An uncrewed Mercury rocket ignited on the pad and rose a few inches.
Then its engine suddenly shut down, and it settled back onto the pad.
The escape tower fired and flew off on its own.
Two electrical plugs had disconnected in the wrong order.
One was slightly longer than the other.
That sequence told the rocket to shut down.
Umbilical design and electrical sequencing were changed.

aciklama:
Mercury-Redstone 1 rose a few inches and shut down. The cause: electrical sequencing fault from umbilical plugs of different lengths separating out of order.
